thesis: Greater creative power intensifies rather than removes the need to justify imposed vulnerability.

ideas.statement: Free-will and suffering defenses must count victims’ freedom, nonhuman harms and costs; power to create does not alone establish ownership or legitimacy.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The thought experiment settles neither God’s existence nor all theodicy; logical compatibility differs from actual justification, knowledge differs from causation and future compensation need not justify present harm.

audit.notes: All source units read directly; thought experiments and unresolved theological issues kept conditional.
